A full-minute clean cascade is a great target, Riley, and 15 minutes a day is enough to get there.

• Goal: a clean 3-ball cascade for a full minute
• Setup today: grab three balls (rolled-up socks work too) and stand over a bed or couch so drops are easy to grab
• Day 1, 6 pm, 15 min: toss one ball hand to hand in an arc to eye level, 20 times. Then do the two-ball swap. Finish with a few three-ball starts
• Schedule: Mon to Fri, 6 pm, 15 minutes
• Proof: a 1 to 2 min phone video of your best attempt. A short clip of a few throws is fine
• Why: the video shows you your throws, and it tracks your progress toward that minute

Each day's step builds on how the last one went, and it all points at that minute. What do you think?
Riley, are you committing to this plan: juggling Mon to Fri at 6 pm, 15 minutes, with a video each day, aiming for that full-minute cascade?
Locked in, Riley! 🔥 Day 1 is today at 6 pm. Grab those three balls and get over the couch. I'll see your video after.

A full-minute cascade is a great target, Riley, and 15 minutes a day gets you there. Here's the plan:

• Goal: a clean 3-ball cascade for a full minute
• Setup today: grab three similar balls (beanbags or rolled-up socks work, since they don't roll away)

• Schedule: Mon to Fri, 6 pm, 15 minutes
• Proof: a 1 to 2 minute video of your best run (a quick voice note about how it went works too)
• Why: filming lets you see your own pattern, and that's how you spot what to fix

Each day's step builds on how the last one went, so we move toward that full minute. What do you think?
Glad it works for you, Riley. Are you committing to this plan, starting today at 6 pm?
